recommendation_en: For preterm infants who need continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy, bubble CPAP may be considered rather than other pressure sources (e.g. ventilator CPAP). (Conditional recommendation, low-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 对于需要持续正压通气（CPAP）治疗的早产儿，可以考虑使用气泡CPAP而不是其他压力源（例如，呼吸机CPAP）。（条件推荐，低确定性证据）
